packet.proposal: Brace the north gable with two diagonal members at 38 degrees to bring lateral drift under the 1/240 span limit at the modelled wind case.
inputs: Lateral wind load case: 1.2 kPa on the north elevation
Timber grade from envelope stage: GL24h glulam
assumptions: Existing timber grade unchanged from the envelope packet
Connections detailed as slotted-in steel plates with dowels
No seismic case governs at this site
packet.rationale: Two symmetric diagonals at 38 degrees resolve the lateral load path into the pier foundations without introducing a new bearing line. Computed drift lands at 0.0038, inside the 1/240 limit of 0.0042, leaving headroom for the connection slip the detail will add.
uncertainties: Connection slip not modelled explicitly; assumed rigid
Wind case is regional, not a site-specific study

decision.note: Drift check reads correctly against the envelope geometry. Released for detailing.

packet.proposal: Route the entry mudroom directly off the ski store so the wet-to-dry path loses one turn and stays under 4 m.
inputs: Ski store capacity: 6 pairs on a north wall rack
Entry approach from the south-east trail
assumptions: Ski store position fixed at the north wall
Bench depth 450 mm, unchanged from the brief
packet.rationale: Removing a turn from the wet-to-dry path shortens it to 3.8 m and keeps meltwater off the living-level floor finish, which the circulation trace flagged as the dominant wear path.
uncertainties: Door swing against the storage bench not checked
Drainage falls in the mudroom slab not yet set

decision.note: The door swing clashes with the storage bench at the 450 mm depth you assumed. Re-run with the swing checked and resubmit.

packet.proposal: Set the roof pitch to 55 degrees to minimise retained snow depth across the whole roof plane.
packet.rationale: Steeper pitch monotonically reduces retained snow depth, so 55 degrees minimises the structural snow case in isolation.
uncertainties: Eave clearance at this pitch not checked against the entry path
Ridge height against the 6 m visibility limit not evaluated

decision.note: Optimises one constraint and drops the two that bind. Eave clearance and the 6 m ridgeline limit are both in the brief — resubmit with those as declared inputs.
